A few things
you might be wondering.

Can I download Nexus-PC yet?

The project is in its feasibility and development stage. There isn’t a public game-running release yet. Follow the GitHub repository for progress and future releases.

Will every PC game work?

Compatibility is still being evaluated. PC games have different requirements, and results will depend on your hardware and the translation stack. A verified games list can be published once there is real testing to report.

Are games streamed from the cloud?

The project’s goal is to run imported games on your Android device using translation runtimes. The planned cloud service matches device and game profiles; it doesn’t stream gameplay.

How can I help build it?

Explore the repository, share ideas through GitHub issues, or contribute to the code. Device testing and game compatibility reports will be useful as the engine becomes available.
